spec_match.rationale: Walks the spec 7.3.1 mix-presentation selection (language annotations, authored loudness layouts, renderer conversion per 7.3.2) over a worked descriptor set, clearly labelled as a model because browsers expose no parsed-OBU JS surface — paired with a real decodingInfo() probe for the modelled sequence.

interactive.rationale: Layout and language selects drive the selection; every candidate card shows why it won or lost; a separate button runs the real probe.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises the selection walkthrough plus the real probe for the selected sequence; both are present and the model/real split is stated up front.

edge_cases.rationale: No-language-match keeps all candidates with an explanation; no-authored-layout falls through to richest-set-plus-renderer-conversion; the probe has missing-surface and rejection branches.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus, spec section 7.3.1, and the explainer.

conformance.rationale: The real-probe half is covered by the v153 suite's resolve-not-reject and surface-existence assertions; 9/9 pass in the verification browser.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP page-driver run (headless Chromium 141): binaural + es-419 selected MP3 with a full per-candidate trace (language loss reasons for MP1/MP2, authored-layout win for MP3); the real probe rendered supported:false with the honest anticipated-153 wording; console and network clean; screenshot v153-iamf-mix.png read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts iamf-mix-selection-ran with layout/lang/winner and iamf-explorer-probe-ran with the boolean-supported check (false on rejection).

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; the selected card uses an accent-blue inline-start border plus the textual SELECTED marker, not colour alone.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled selects, aria-live=polite decoder-output box and role=status trace/probe outputs, and selection state carried in text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Three-column layout collapses via auto-fit minmax(230px,1fr); responsive-check passes both classes; screenshots judged clean.

openQuestions.title: Replace the worked model with real decoder behaviour when observable
openQuestions.detail: If a future Chrome exposes any observable mix-presentation selection (e.g. via debug info or WebCodecs-adjacent surfaces), pair the model with the real selection outcome. Until then the page's model/real labelling is the honest ceiling.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce async result status live region without stealing focus
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give each independently-updating result area an appropriate live region and keep announcements concise.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The decoder-output box is aria-live=polite and the trace and probe outputs are role=status; card selection is also conveyed by the textual '— SELECTED' suffix.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Driver run: trace text listed every candidate's win/loss reason after one click

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use auto-fit minmax columns so multi-column explainers stack on mobile.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: .cols uses repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr)) and cards use overflow-safe text.

summary: v153 refile of the v152 explorer at the shipping-stage milestone; probe wording updated to the anticipated-153 framing. Verified via CDP-driven headless Chromium 141: selection trace correct for binaural/es-419 (MP3 wins on language + authored layout), real probe honestly reports supported:false, clean console/network, both responsive classes pass.
